title: Speaking Practice 28 - Technology and Privacy
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about technology and privacy.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Technology and Privacy Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: Are you concerned about online privacy?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, I am. Companies collect vast amounts of personal data, and data breaches are becoming increasingly common. I try to be careful about what information I share online.

questions.content: Should governments have access to personal data for security?

explanation.sampleAnswer: There needs to be a balance. Some surveillance may be necessary for national security, but it should be regulated with judicial oversight to prevent abuse of power.

questions.content: How has technology changed the concept of privacy?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Technology has fundamentally eroded traditional privacy. Social media encourages sharing personal moments publicly, smart devices listen to conversations, and our online activity is constantly tracked.

questions.content: What steps can people take to protect their privacy online?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Using strong passwords, enabling two-factor authentication, being cautious about app permissions, and using VPNs are practical steps everyone should take.

questions.content: Do children understand the risks of sharing information online?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Most children do not fully understand the long-term consequences. Digital literacy education from an early age is crucial to help them navigate online risks safely.
